items: hoy is a time period that isn't over yet, and in Spain the perfecto is used.
Today I got up at seven.
ayer is a closed time period, so indefinido.
Yesterday we went to the beach.
Cuando era pequeña, siempre ___ en la calle.
A past habit (siempre, de pequeña) takes the imperfecto.
When I was little, I always played in the street.
Este año ___ tres veces a España.
este año isn't over yet, so perfecto.
This year I've travelled to Spain three times.
El año pasado ___ seis meses en Barcelona.
A closed, defined period (seis meses, el año pasado) takes the indefinido.
Last year I lived in Barcelona for six months.
mientras describes a background action: imperfecto. The event that interrupts it (sonó) is indefinido.
While I was cooking, the phone rang.
Anoche ___ muy cansada, así que me acosté pronto.
Describing a state that is the background to an action: imperfecto.
Last night I was very tired, so I went to bed early.
Life experience (alguna vez) takes the perfecto.
A specific date in the past takes the indefinido.
In 2010 I saw Paris for the first time.
todavía no connects to now, so perfecto.
I haven't finished the homework yet.
De niña siempre ___ miedo a los perros.
de niña + siempre describes a past state and habit: imperfecto.
As a child I was always afraid of dogs.
Cuando llegamos al hotel, ___ mucho calor.
Weather as the background to an event: imperfecto.
When we got to the hotel, it was very hot.
ahora mismo is attached to the present: perfecto.
I've just sent you the homework.
La semana pasada la profesora me ___ un texto sobre Perú.
la semana pasada is a closed period: indefinido.
Last week the teacher gave me a text about Peru.
Antes ___ en una tienda, pero ahora estudio.
antes meaning 'in the past' (a situation that has ended) takes the imperfecto.
I used to work in a shop, but now I'm studying.
esta semana isn't over yet: perfecto.
This week we've had two classes.
de repente marks a sudden event: indefinido.
La casa ___ grande y tenía un jardín precioso.
Describing a place in the past: imperfecto.
The house was big and had a lovely garden.
hace dos días is a closed time: indefinido.
Two days ago we arrived in Lisbon.
Todos los veranos ___ al pueblo de mis abuelos.
todos los veranos is a habit: imperfecto.
Every summer we went to my grandparents' village.
el fin de semana pasado is closed: indefinido. Note: hiciste, without a c.
What did you do last weekend?
nunca meaning 'never up to now' takes the perfecto.
Eran las once de la noche y la gente todavía ___.
Describing what was going on in the background at a given time: imperfecto.
It was eleven at night and people were still having dinner.
Hoy no nos ___ porque hacía mal tiempo.
We didn't go in the water today because the weather was bad.
Yo ___ a las siete y media.
e→ie in the stem, and a reflexive verb needs me.
I wake up at half past seven.
We live in a small flat.
e→ie in the stem: quiero, quieres, quiere.
Do you want to go to the cinema tonight?
Yo no ___ dónde está la estación.
saber is irregular in the yo form: sé.
I don't know where the station is.
Mis amigos ___ a casa a las diez.
o→ue in the stem: vuelvo, vuelves, vuelven.
My friends come home at ten.
decir: yo digo (-go), and the rest e→i: dices, dice.
vosotros in Spain: -áis. Hablan is ellos or ustedes.
Do you speak Spanish at home?
Yo ___ la mesa antes de cenar.
I set the table before dinner.
Yo ___ del trabajo a las seis.
Yo ___ los textos a mi idioma.
I translate the texts into my language.
Mi hermana ___ ocho horas cada noche.
o→ue in the stem: duermo, duermes, duerme.
My sister sleeps eight hours every night.
o→ue: cuesta. The subject is one book, so singular.
How much does this book cost?
Nosotros ___ a trabajar a las ocho.
No vowel change in the nosotros form: empezamos.
Por la noche ___ mucho ruido en la calle.
oír: yo oigo, tú oyes, él oye.
At night I hear a lot of noise in the street.
El niño ___ un helado de chocolate.
e→i in the stem: pido, pides, pide.
The boy asks for a chocolate ice cream.
Yo ___ a tu hermana de la universidad.
I know your sister from university.
Yo ___ tres primos y una prima.
tener: yo tengo (-go), and the rest e→ie: tienes.
I have three male cousins and one female cousin.
e→i in the stem: sigo, sigues, siguen.
What time do you usually go to bed?
In the afternoon I do yoga.
No vowel change in the vosotros form: podéis.
Can you come tomorrow at five?
No change in the nosotros form: nos vestimos.
Yo ___ a clase los martes y los jueves.
ir is completely irregular: voy, vas, va.
I go to class on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
Yo ___ clases de inglés a niños.
I give English lessons to children.
According to the forecast, it will rain tomorrow.
El año que viene ___ a España.
el año que viene signals the future: viajaremos.
Next year we'll travel to Spain.
ir a + infinitive: something you can see is about to happen.
Look at those clouds: it's going to rain.
hacer is irregular in the future: haré, harás.
What will you do at the weekend?
I don't know if I'll have time tomorrow.
Te lo ___ mañana, ahora no puedo.
I'll tell you tomorrow, I can't right now.
On Saturday we'll be able to meet for dinner.
Mis amigos ___ a visitarnos en verano.
venir in the future: vendré, vendrán.
My friends will come to visit us in the summer.
Mañana ___ de casa a las ocho.
Tomorrow I'll leave home at eight.
In 2030 there will be more electric cars.
ser is regular in the future: será.
My birthday will be on Friday.
futuro simple in the vosotros form: -éis.
With practice, you'll learn very quickly.
El próximo verano ___ en práctica todo lo que he aprendido.
Next summer I'll put everything I've learned into practice.
Tomorrow we'll know the exam results.
ir a + infinitive: a plan. Don't forget the a.
This afternoon I'm going to study for the exam.
ir a + infinitive: vais a venir.
Are you going to come to Ana's party?
I'll call you when I get to the hotel.
In the future the stem doesn't change: corregir + á.
The teacher will correct my homework tomorrow.
La cafetería ___ en el segundo piso.
Location of a place or thing: estar.
The cafeteria is on the second floor.
La fiesta ___ en casa de Ana.
Where an event takes place: ser. (The house is located somewhere, but the party takes place.)
The party is at Ana's house.
La sopa ___ fría, voy a calentarla.
The state of something right now: estar.
The soup is cold, I'm going to heat it up.
A characteristic of the place: ser.
La abuela de Pedro ___ en el hospital.
How someone looks at a given moment: estar.
You look so pretty today in that dress!
El chico ___ muy listo: aprende todo rápido.
ser listo: clever (a trait). estar listo: ready.
The boy is very clever: he learns everything quickly.
¿Ya ___ lista? Nos vamos en cinco minutos.
Are you ready yet? We're leaving in five minutes.
En mi barrio ___ un mercado muy bueno.
In my neighbourhood there's a very good market.
El mercado ___ al lado de la estación.
Location of a specific thing (el mercado): está.
The market is next to the station.
No ___ cómo se dice esto en español.
I don't know how to say this in Spanish.
___ a una chica de Valencia muy simpática.
I know a very nice girl from Valencia.
Knowing how to do something: saber + infinitive.
Quiero ___ Sevilla el año que viene.
Getting to know a place (visiting it): conocer.
I want to visit Seville next year.
Voy a ___ a la profesora qué significa esta palabra.
I'm going to ask the teacher what this word means.
En el restaurante ___ una paella para dos.
Asking for or ordering something: pedir.
At the restaurant we ordered a paella for two.
Cuando vengas a mi casa, ___ el postre, por favor.
To bring here, to where I am: traer.
When you come to my house, bring the dessert, please.
Mañana ___ el vino a la cena de Ana.
To take there, to another place: llevar.
Tomorrow I'm taking the wine to dinner at Ana's.

condicional.name: Conditional and if-clauses
condicional.rule: si + imperfecto de subjuntivo, condicional: Si tuviera dinero, viajaría.

futuro.name: Future: futuro simple and ir a
futuro.rule: futuro simple: infinitive + é, ás, á, emos, éis, án (viajaré, comerás). Irregular stems: tendré, haré, diré, podré, saldré, vendré, pondré, sabré, habrá. ir a + infinitive: a plan or something about to happen (voy a estudiar, va a llover).

pasado.name: Which past? perfecto, indefinido, imperfecto
pasado.rule: perfecto (he hecho): a period that isn't over (hoy, esta semana, este año) and experience (alguna vez, nunca, todavía). indefinido (hice): closed time and events (ayer, el año pasado, en 2010, de repente). imperfecto (hacía): background, description, habit (siempre, de niña, antes, mientras).

presente.name: Present: irregular verbs
presente.rule: Vowel change in the stressed stem: e→ie (quiero), o→ue (vuelvo), e→i (pido). No change in nosotros and vosotros (queremos). Irregular yo: -go (tengo, hago, pongo, salgo, digo), -zco (conozco, traduzco). Special: soy, voy, doy, sé. Reflexives: me, te, se, nos, os, se.

serestar.name: ser vs estar and other confusing verbs
serestar.rule: ser: who and what (identity, profession, origin, permanent trait, time, where an event takes place). estar: how and where (temporary state, feeling, location of a thing or person). hay: something exists (hay un café), está: where it is (el café está aquí). saber: to know information or how to do something, conocer: to know a person or place. pedir: to ask for, preguntar: to ask a question. llevar: to take there, traer: to bring here.

subjuntivo.name: Basic subjunctive
subjuntivo.rule: After querer que, pedir que, no creer que, para que, and in negative commands.
